={{
{
  client_id: $json.client_id,

  paid_ads_commentary: $json.paid_ads_commentary,
  seo_commentary: $json.seo_commentary,
  mom_commentary: $json.mom_commentary,
  wins: Array.isArray($json.wins) ? $json.wins : [],
  watchouts: Array.isArray($json.watchouts) ? $json.watchouts : [],
  next_steps: Array.isArray($json.next_steps) ? $json.next_steps : [],
  paid_ads_summary: $json.paid_ads_summary,
  seo_summary: $json.seo_summary,
  mom_summary: $json.mom_summary,
  published_at: null,
  updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
}
}}

parameters.content:
Workflow: Monthly Report Generator - Client Portal

Runs on the 1st of each month at 6:00 AM. Configure the workflow timezone to America/Los_Angeles in n8n so the cron fires in Pacific time.

Initial scope: Press Burger only. Reports save as draft and published_at remains null.

The workflow reads stored metrics from Supabase and does not generate metrics with AI. AI only interprets finalized JSON.

If outbound click rate is above 100%, the commentary normalization adds a watchout about tracking duplication or attribution scope.

Slack nodes are disabled placeholders. Set CLICK_CRAFTERS_REPORTS_SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL or replace these with your Slack credential/channel nodes, then enable them.

Alerts exist for draft generated, no data, and published report already exists.
